Here the winning deck for the EC V5 event on friday 17th of october 2025.
Player: Jeroen van oort

Deck Name: the Power Structure
Description: A build and vote deck.
A meta respons to shroud of decay and bleed. I wanted to have a deck that is able to fail to defend against the onslaught of pool damage and live.

Early game: transfer, govern, villein, almost never bleed.
Midgame: adapt and cosolidate your votebase
Lategame. Maybe bleed
